note: v13 sliding cargo doors (Unity prefab space, m). t = cargoDoorL / cargoDoorR (0 closed .. 1 open). Pose: localRotation = AngleAxis(side * yawDeg, up) * rest, localPosition = rest + (side * outRear, 0, -back), side = -1 left / +1 right (outward). p = t / popEnd; outFront = out * S3(p / 0.75), outRear = out * S3((p - 0.25) / 0.75), back = slide * S5((t - slideStart) / (1 - slideStart)); outRear -= tuck * s^2, s = clamp01((back - tuckStart) / (slide - tuckStart)) (the rear follows the tapering side); yawDeg = atan2(outFront - outRear, length) (front swings out first). S3 = smoothstep, S5 = smootherstep. UtilityPlaneRig.SlidingDoorPose gives the same pose (use it for presentation and obstruction tests).
